title: Spoken to, then a pause mid-sentence
about: End of turn for a voice agent addressed by name: a 1.7 s pause after a trailing 'uh' is not the end of the request. A silence-only end-of-turn detector would reply at about 0.8 s.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Egg Head, can you check the, uh…
lines.why: addressed but not finished (Decider says so, and the words trail off): wait

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: the checkout queue? How backed up is it?
lines.why: finished: acknowledge at once, answer when the lookup is back
